label:
Probiotic
milk drink
comment: Not yoghurt: one probiotic strain on its own, without the yoghurt cultures.

about.text: Milk fermented with a single strain of probiotic bacteria rather than with yoghurt cultures, such as acidophilus milk, made with Lactobacillus acidophilus, or Yakult, a small sweetened drink of skimmed milk fermented with Lactobacillus casei Shirota since 1935.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: One probiotic strain, not the usual yoghurt pair, sours skimmed milk at about body temperature. Which strain and how long differs: see the examples, Yakult (L. paracasei Shirota, days) and acidophilus milk (L. acidophilus, about 36 h).

steps.note: Yakult takes days, acidophilus milk about 1.5 d.
